protocol_declared.ratio_law: ratio(node, joint, set) = |tau(node, joint)| / cap(joint, set); over-cap := ratio > 1.0. Binding node of a joint := argmax ratio. Worst-case ratio of a set := max over joints and nodes; the binding-adjacent HOLDING class := the largest sub-unity ratio (the joint nearest its cap among holders - the margin-binder).
protocol_declared.wall_reprice_law: wall_ratio(set) = max over the 21 banked nodes of max(hip_r, knee_r x capA_knee/capB_knee, ankle_r, mp_r x capA_mp/capB_mp, posture_r) with capA the (a) caps - i.e. each joint's banked ratio is divided by that joint's cap headroom; hip/ankle/posture headroom is 1.0 in sets (b)/(c) by the held-cap law. crossing_1_0 := wall_ratio <= 1.0 at EVERY node. margin_0_9 := wall_ratio <= 0.9 at every node.
